degrees.title: Master of Applied Computer Science
degrees.summary: A coursework-based master's. Alongside my own courses I was {{Lab Assistant and Project Coordinator}} for the Data Management and Warehousing course for [[2 consecutive terms]], delivering labs and managing project groups.

projects.name: RDBMS in Java from scratch
projects.framing: A relational database engine built {{from scratch}} in Java: parser, storage, transactions. I wrote it to understand the layers instead of using them.
bullets: Built test-first: each layer had its tests before it had its implementation, run through [[Maven]].
Leaned on explicit design patterns so the parser, the storage layer and the transaction handling stayed separable.
Hand-rolled the data structures the engine needed rather than pulling in a library.

projects.name: Cab Booking Management
projects.framing: A cab booking management application in Java, built around {{SOLID}} principles, design patterns and a CI/CD pipeline.
bullets: Held to SOLID principles and design patterns so each responsibility sat in exactly one place.
Test-driven with Maven, on a {{GitFlow}} branching model wired to CI/CD.

projects.name: Hiree — job posting portal
projects.framing: An online portal for posting jobs and finding them. {{Spring Boot}} on the backend, containerized, running on AWS.
bullets: Spring Boot backend, built with Maven.
Packaged as a {{Docker}} image and run on EC2.
Relational data in RDS, files in S3, notifications through SNS.

projects.name: Volunteer Mart
projects.framing: A volunteer marketplace: a {{React}} front end over a Node.js API, with the data in a relational database on GCP.
bullets: React in the browser, Node.js behind it, so both sides run one language.
Persistence in a relational database managed by [[GCP]].
